title: Sicilia's Diesel Prices Pull Away from the National Average
dek: Self-service diesel in Sicilia has climbed nearly 4 cents in a week, now running almost 2 cents above what drivers pay on average across Italy.
body: Today's region of the day is Sicilia, where self-service Benzina is holding at €2.029 per liter, essentially matching Italy's national self-service average of €2.028 — a gap of just a tenth of a cent. Diesel tells a different story: Sicilia's self-service Gasolio sits at €2.183 per liter, nearly 1.9 cents above the national self-service average of €2.165, making the island one of the pricier spots in the country to fill a diesel tank right now.

The trend line is what stands out. Over the last week of tracked data, Sicilia's self-service Benzina has risen steadily from €2.008 to €2.029 — about 2 cents — while Gasolio has climbed faster, from €2.146 to €2.183, nearly 3.7 cents in the same stretch. The region currently counts 1,993 registered stations, with 1,774 reporting prices today, a modest dip from the roughly 1,779 reporting a week earlier and a reminder that a small slice of the local network skips its daily update on any given day.

Numbers like these — a specific region, a specific week, a specific spread against the national picture — are only worth publishing daily because nothing about producing them is manual anymore. Fuel Dashboard pulls the official MIMIT feed, recomputes every regional and national figure, and rotates through Italy's 20 regions on its own each day, all without anyone touching a spreadsheet. It's built and kept running with Claude Code, which is exactly the point: this kind of daily, per-region detail is only practical when the whole pipeline rebuilds itself.

caption:
Today's Fuel Dashboard spotlight: Sicilia, where self-service diesel has climbed nearly 4 cents in a week and now sits almost 2 cents above Italy's national average, while gasoline is holding right in line with the rest of the country.

Fuel Dashboard is a free, self-updating dashboard tracking fuel prices across all of Italy's regions, pulling directly from the official MIMIT feed every day. No manual data entry, no stale spreadsheet — just the current national and regional picture for Benzina, Gasolio, GPL and Metano, updated automatically. Take a look at today's numbers and the full regional breakdown at https://adeo-blip.github.io/fuel-price-italy/

The part I find genuinely useful here isn't just the data — it's how it gets produced. This entire dashboard, including the daily region rotation, the price processing, and even the article you're reading a summary of right now, is built and run with Claude Code. A year ago this would have been a recurring chore: downloading a CSV, updating a sheet, writing up the numbers by hand. Now it's a pipeline that rebuilds itself every morning. That's the real case for using AI coding tools on projects like this — not replacing analysis, but removing the manual maintenance that used to make daily, per-region reporting impractical.
